name: @activepieces/piece-dumpling-ai
description: Transform unstructured website content into clean, AI-ready data

auth.description: You can obtain API key from [API Section](https://app.dumplingai.com/api-keys).

web_search.name: web_search
web_search.description: Search the web and optionally retrieve content from top results.

country.description: Two-letter country code for location bias (e.g., "US" for United States).

location.description: Specific location to focus the search (e.g., "New York, NY").

language.description: Language code for the search results (e.g., "en" for English).

scrapeResults.description: Whether to scrape top search results.

numResultsToScrape.description: Number of top results to scrape (max: 10).

cleanedOutput.description: Whether the scraped output should be cleaned.

aiMetadata.description: Runs a live web search on Dumpling AI for a query, with optional country/location/language and date-range filtering. Can operate in two modes: results-only, or with "Scrape Results" enabled it also fetches and returns the page content of the top N results (markdown, HTML, or screenshot). Use to find current web pages or grab their content in one step. Not idempotent: each call is a fresh billed search whose results reflect live web state.

search_news.name: search_news
search_news.description: Search for news articles using Google News.

query.description: The search query for Google News.

country.description: Country code for location bias (e.g., "US" for United States).

location.description: Specific location to focus the search (e.g., "New York, NY").

language.description: Language code for the search results (e.g., "en" for English).

aiMetadata.description: Searches Google News via Dumpling AI for a query, with optional country/location/language and date-range filtering plus pagination. Choose this over the general web search when the agent needs news articles specifically. Not idempotent: each call is a fresh billed search reflecting live news at request time.

generate_image.name: generate_image
generate_image.description: Generate images based on a text prompt using AI.

model.description: The model to use for image generation

prompt.description: The text prompt for image generation

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image

aiMetadata.description: Generates one or more images from a text prompt using a selectable FLUX or recraft model on Dumpling AI, with optional aspect ratio, output format, image count, and seed. Use when the agent needs to create images from a description. Not idempotent: each call is a fresh billed generation; even with a fixed seed it produces new output and consumes credits.

scrape_website.name: scrape_website
scrape_website.description: Scrapes data from a specified URL and format the result.

cleaned.description: Whether the output should be cleaned.

renderJs.description: Whether to render JavaScript before scraping.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the content of a single given URL via Dumpling AI and returns it as markdown, HTML, or a screenshot, with optional content cleaning and JavaScript rendering. Use to read one specific page; use Crawl Website instead to follow links across many pages. Not idempotent: each call is a fresh billed fetch reflecting the live page.

crawl_website.name: crawl_website
crawl_website.description: Crawl a website and return structured content from multiple pages.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl.

depth.description: Depth of crawling (distance between base URL path and sub paths).

aiMetadata.description: Crawls a website starting from a given URL via Dumpling AI, following links up to a configurable page limit and depth, and returns each page as markdown, text, or raw content. Use when the agent needs content from many pages of a site at once; use Scrape Website for a single known URL. Not idempotent: each call is a fresh billed crawl reflecting live site state.

extract_document.name: extract_document
extract_document.description: Extract structured data from documents using vision-capable AI.

prompt.description: The prompt describing what data to extract from the document.

jsonMode.description: Whether to return the result in JSON format.

aiMetadata.description: Extracts data from an uploaded document (file or base64) using vision-capable AI on Dumpling AI, guided by a free-text extraction prompt, optionally returning the result as JSON. Use to pull fields or content out of PDFs, images, or scanned files. Not idempotent: each call is a fresh billed AI extraction whose output may vary.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: You can obtain API key from [API Section](https://app.dumplingai.com/api-keys).

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: You can obtain API key from [API Section](https://app.dumplingai.com/api-keys).

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
